vBRIEFInfo.author: agent:oz
vBRIEFInfo.description: Upgrade libxumux wire format to the xumux.org 8-byte fixed frame header spec

narratives.Description: Migrate libxumux from the old 6-byte variable-width frame header to the new xumux.org 8-byte fixed header. The new header layout is [Channel:2][Type:1][Flags:1][Length:4]. Channel field grows from 1 byte to 2 bytes (big-endian, 65,534 app channels). Payload Length is always 4 bytes (max ~4GB), eliminating the EXTENDED_LENGTH flag and variable header size. The Reserved byte is removed. Flags bit 0 is now reserved (was EXTENDED_LENGTH). Fragmentation (FRAGMENT/FRAGMENT_END) is retained. This is a breaking wire format change.
narratives.Decisions: Strict 8-byte only — no backward compat with old 6-byte frames. Default max fragment size stays 65535 (64KB). Hard remove all deleted public exports (EXTENDED_LENGTH, STANDARD_HEADER_SIZE, EXTENDED_HEADER_SIZE, HEADER_RESERVED_BYTE, MAX_STANDARD_PAYLOAD). XUMUX_VERSION bumped to [0, 2, 0].
narratives.Scope: constants.ts (remove/replace 5 constants, add HEADER_SIZE), frame.ts (doc update), encode-frame.ts (rewrite encoder for fixed 8-byte header), decode-frame.ts (rewrite decoder + FrameDecoder for fixed 8-byte header), fragment.ts (swap default constant), channel.ts (swap constant, update docs), index.ts (remove stale exports), types.ts (bump version), control/handler.ts (update MAX_CHANNEL_ID refs). All corresponding test files.
